english.note: Choose this for the direct, usually written or technical sense of being catastrophe-related or disastrous.
Use this as the direct, all-purpose description, especially before a noun such as 災難性嘅風暴.
Use this as the precise, formal description of something calamitous or likely to cause disaster.
Use this when the result or consequences are genuinely disastrous or calamitous, rather than merely poor.

examples.traditional: 是次事故造成災難性後果。
